review: Absolutely love this phone. The camera system is unreal — ProRes video on a phone!
Battery life is disappointing for the price. Expected more from Apple.
The titanium build feels premium. Best phone I've ever owned.
USB-C switch is a game changer. Finally.
Gets warm during gaming sessions. Not ideal.
Snapdragon chip makes this blazing fast. No lag whatsoever.
Display is gorgeous. Colours are vibrant and blacks are deep.
Camera app is a bit complex but photos turn out great.
Bixby is still annoying and can't be fully disabled.
Great value vs iPhone. Switching was the right call.
The AI features are genuinely useful
Seven years of OS updates is a huge deal for longevity.
Night Sight is still the best low-light camera on any phone.
Fingerprint reader is a bit slow compared to competitors.
Pure Android experience — no bloatware at all.
Fastest charging I have ever seen. 0 to 100 in under 30 minutes.
Hasselblad camera tuning is noticeably better than last year.
OxygenOS feels clean but a few Samsung habits crept in.
Speaker quality is surprisingly good for the price.
No wireless charging in some regions is frustrating.
